Snapshot per-row conv_state/ssm_state, skip the idle update, and prove the rows are unchanged after the zero-token step; never reuse idle metadata for a scheduled batch.

fallback_boundary.active_batch: When the local batch is non-empty, do not use the idle zero-pad path; take the scheduled decode path and keep the normal state update.
fallback_boundary.static_capture_shape: When graph capture shape is static, do not force a dynamic zero-pad replay; use the declared static-shape path or re-capture under the new shape.
fallback_boundary.hCCl_unavailable: When HCCL participation cannot be established, report the execution-condition failure and stop; never fake a collective or hide the timeout.
